name: manual_fc1b75
claim: A ruleset with strict_required_status_checks_policy requires the PR head to be current with its base: mergeStateStatus BEHIND with mergeable MERGEABLE is not a conflict. Prove it locally first (git merge-tree for textual conflicts, then the suites on the merged tree for semantic ones), then update the branch server-side without force and wait for the required checks on the new head before merging. UNSTABLE with only non-required checks pending is still mergeable.

decisions.notes: oramasys PR 36, 2026-10-14: reported as a merge conflict, it was BEHIND by three commits touching two unrelated test files; merge-tree was clean and 726 tests passed on the merged tree; gh pr update-branch plus 10 required checks was the whole fix.
